inputs.text: [excited] Jig… ah… no… toh… saurus. [curious] "Giga" means giant — like in "gigantic." "Noto" means from the south. And "saurus" means lizard.
[amazed] Giant from the south, like "gigantic" but a lizard.
[happily] Exactly. It lived in Argentina, in South America, [amazed] ninety-eight million years ago.
[curious] What did a giant like that even hunt?
[playful] Andesaurus. [confident] A long-necked cousin, as tall as a building, that lived in the very same area.
